name: Tabatinga
source: Agencia Nacional de Aguas e Saneamento Basico (ANA), HidroWeb web service
datum: cm above the local staff gauge zero (ANA does not publish the zero's elevation in this service)
license: No license on the HidroWeb service itself. The SNIRH metadata record for the national hydrometric network allows reproduction of the data provided the source is cited (https://metadados.snirh.gov.br/geonetwork/srv/api/records/f85dbf06-a869-414c-afc5-bb01869e9156). Credit: Agencia Nacional de Aguas e Saneamento Basico (ANA), HidroWeb.
notes: Datum check: 516 days where both the historic series and telemetry have a value (2025-01-01 to 2026-05-31); telemetry daily mean minus historic value: median +0.0 cm, mean -0.0 cm, 5th-95th percentile -1.0 to +1.0 cm. A median near zero means the two share the same gauge zero.

Historic series: ANA HidroSerieHistorica, tipoDados=1 (stage). Where a month exists at consistency level 2 (consistent, reviewed by ANA) we use it; otherwise level 1 (raw) and mark it provisional. Last level-2 date: 2023-12-31. Level-1 days used: 928.

Per-day status codes from ANA (CotaNNStatus): 340 days flagged 2 'estimated' are marked estimated; 0 days flagged 3 'doubtful' and 0 days flagged 4 'dry staff gauge' are kept as published with their consistency-level quality.

Daily value: ANA's daily-mean row where published (normally the mean of the 07:00 and 17:00 staff readings); otherwise the mean of the reading rows for that day. Days by source row: {'daily_mean_row': 15682}.

Historic record ends 2026-05-31. Days after that come from the ANA telemetry feed (DadosHidrometeorologicos, mostly 15-minute readings), averaged to a daily mean (140 days, marked provisional). Telemetry days with fewer than 12 readings: 140. Dropped as partial days (fewer than 75% of the readings the gauge usually sends per day, the median over the 61 days around it): 2, most recent 2026-07-24, 2026-10-20.
No fill values found in this series; ANA leaves missing days blank.
Share of days marked estimated by decade: {2000: 0.07, 2010: 0.023, 2020: 0.001}.
ANA inventory altitude for the station: 78 m (station altitude, not the gauge zero).

measurement_history.fact: ANA inventory: staff gauge readings start 1982-07-01 and continue. Operator SGB-CPRM.
ANA inventory: telemetry starts 2000-08-01. No automatic level recorder is listed.
Data check: several one-day jumps of 3 to 4 m in 1989-1992 (for example 990 cm on 1992-07-01 to 03, then 612 cm) in raw (level 1) months. Kept as published.
SGB: recent readings can be revised after field visits that include re-leveling of the staff gauges.
Not found: number and hour of daily readings, gauge moves, gauge zero elevation, any publisher statement on early accuracy.

public_notes: This gauge starts in 1982, so it covers only about 44 years. Values after 2023 have not yet been reviewed by Brazil's water agency, and a few days in 1989 to 1992 show jumps that look like recording errors.
